$comment: S1-3: the block types a game's meshes use that the schema has no definition for. Measured by niftypes, which reads only the header's type-name list and decodes nothing, so it is a question about the schema's coverage rather than about layouts. A type listed here is a block the reader cannot read at all - a different and cheaper thing to fix than a block it reads wrongly. Regenerated 2026-10-29, after the Fallout 4 and Skyrim layers were generated from Bethesda's nif.xml: no game has an undefined type left.
measured_by: cargo run -p nvre-vfs --example niftypes -- <data dir> <schema chain>
